Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The error occurred because WebSurfer misidentified the prize associated with Adam Smith. Instead of confirming the relevant prize through official sources, the WebSurfer agent reported the Adam Smith Awards from Treasury Today as the primary finding. This mistake arose from over-relying on initial search results, which revealed multiple prizes associated with the same name, without adequately cross-verifying or filtering out unrelated results using authoritative or context-specific sources. This resulted in presenting an incorrect context (corporate Treasury Today award) unrelated to the task, which sought the prize named after Adam Smith, the author of "The Wealth of Nations," specifically the Adam Smith Prize related to the academic context of economics at Cambridge University.
